name: Osaki-Hirokoji
tagline: Shinagawa in 12 minutes and Shibuya in 16 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥120,000 to ¥130,000.
summary: The station is in Shinagawa City, where Tokyu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 30 minutes to Otemachi, 25 minutes to Shinjuku, 16 minutes to Shibuya and 12 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. The station stands 6.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 19.1 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 6.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 2.7 m to 21.8 m, a difference of 19.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 4 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 4 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: まいばすけっと 西五反田2丁目店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 5 clinics and 15 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is サザンガーデンクリニック, about 8 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 有仁会阿部病院, about 11 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Ikegami Line.
congestion: Tokyu Ikegami Line runs at 130% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 大崎広小路→五反田, which includes this station. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥120,000 to ¥130,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000 and 2LDK ¥310,000 to ¥320,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Gotanda; for how easy the shopping is, Osaki-Hirokoji.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Osaki-Hirokoji. Both have the Tokyu Ikegami Line. Gotanda also has the JR Yamanote Line and Toei Asakusa Line, which Osaki-Hirokoji does not. Gotanda is at least 7 minutes quicker to Toranomon and Shinjuku. On how easy the shopping is, though, Osaki-Hirokoji comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Osaki-Hirokoji has 12 supermarkets (東急ストア and 成城石井 and others) and Gotanda has 8.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Osaki; for how easy the shopping is, Osaki-Hirokoji.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Osaki-Hirokoji. Osaki-Hirokoji adds the Tokyu Ikegami Line; Osaki adds the 4 lines. Osaki is at least 9 minutes quicker to Shinjuku and Tokyo. A one-room flat also costs about ¥10,000 less at Osaki. On how easy the shopping is, though, Osaki-Hirokoji comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Osaki-Hirokoji has 12 supermarkets (東急ストア and 成城石井 and others) and Osaki has 7.

goodFor: People who want to finish their shopping on foot
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: The 首都高速2号目黒線 viaduct runs a short walk from the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
山手通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 12 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 7 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyu Ikegami Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: This station sits on the busiest stretch of the Tokyu Ikegami Line, but at 130% passengers are not shoulder to shoulder.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
